title: Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase

abstractEnglish: We prove worst-case total-variation cutoff for the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics at every fixed inverse temperature $`0\leq\beta\lt 1`$. With rate-one refresh at each spin, the cutoff location is $`\log n/(2\lambda(\beta))`$ for a positive deterministic rate $`\lambda(\beta)`$. The location for uniformly chosen single-site update attempts is n times as large. Convergence is in probability over the disorder.
titleEn: Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase

details.overview: 稿件研究零场Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick热浴动力学在高温相中的混合时间截断。作者声称，对每个固定逆温度0≤β<1，最坏情况总变差截断成立；每个自旋以速率一刷新时，截断位置为log n/(2λ(β))，其中λ(β)为正的确定性速率；均匀选择单点更新尝试时位置为n倍。收敛在无序上依概率成立。摘要未给出证明细节。
